title: Score de physiologie aiguë simplifié (SAPS) 3
formula:
The SAPS 3 Score is calculated by adding the selected points for each variable:

| Variable | Points | | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ICU admission | Every patient gets an offset of 16 points for being admitted (to avoid negative SAPS 3 scores) | | 16 |
| Age, years | | <40 | 0 |
| 40-59 | 5 | | |
| 60-69 | 9 | | |
| 70-74 | 13 | | |
| 75-79 | 15 | | |
| ≥80 | 18 | | |
| Comorbidities | Chemotherapy, immunosuppression, radiotherapy, steroids | Cancer therapy | 3 |
| | Chronic HF (NYHA IV) | 6 | |
| | Hematological cancer | 6 | |
| | Cirrhosis | 8 | |
| | AIDS | 8 | |
| | Metastatic cancer | 11 | |
| Length of stay before ICU admission, days | | <14 | 0 |
| 14-27 | 6 | | |
| ≥28 | 7 | | |
| Intrahospital location before ICU admission | | Emergency room | 5 |
| Other ICU | 7 | | |
| Other ward | 8 | | |
| Use of major therapeutic options before ICU admission | | Other/none | 0 |
| Vasoactive drugs | 3 | | |
| Planned or unplanned ICU admission | | Planned | 0 |
| Unplanned | 3 | | |
| Reason(s) for ICU admission | If both reasons are present, only the worse value (-4) is scored | Cardiovascular: rhythm disturbances | -5 |
| Neurologic: seizures | -4 | | |
| | Cardiovascular: hypovolemic hemorrhagic shock, hypovolemic non-hemorrhagic shock | 3 | |
| | Digestive: acute abdomen, other | 3 | |
| | Neurologic: coma, stupor, obtunded patient, vigilance disturbances, confusion, agitation, delirium | 4 | |
| | Cardiovascular: septic shock | 5 | |
| | Cardiovascular: anaphylactic shock, mixed and undefined shock | 5 | |
| | Hepatic: liver failure | 6 | |
| | Neurologic: focal neurologic deficit | 7 | |
| | Digestive: severe pancreatitis | 9 | |
| | Neurologic: intracranial mass effect | 10 | |
| | Other | 0 | |
| Anatomical site of surgery | | Transplant surgery | -11 |
| Trauma surgery | -8 | | |
| Cardiac surgery: CABG without valvular repair | -6 | | |
| Neurosurgery: cerebrovascular accident | 5 | | |
| Other surgery | 0 | | |
| Surgical status at ICU admission | | Scheduled surgery | 0 |
| No surgery | 5 | | |
| Emergency surgery | 6 | | |
| Acute infection at ICU admission | | Other/none | 0 |
| Nosocomial | 4 | | |
| Respiratory | 5 | | |
| Glasgow Coma Scale | Lowest within 1 hr of ICU admission | ≥13 | 0 |
| 7-12 | 2 | | |
| 6 | 7 | | |
| 5 | 10 | | |
| 3-4 | 15 | | |
| Total bilirubin, mg/dL (µmol/L) | Highest within 1 hr of ICU admission | <2 mg/dL (<34.2 µmol/L) | 0 |
| 2-5.9 mg/dL (34.2-102.5 µmol/L) | 4 | | |
| ≥6 mg/dL (≥102.6 µmol/L) | 5 | | |
| Body temperature, °C (°F) | Highest within 1 hr of ICU admission | ≥35 °C (≥95 °F) | 0 |
| <35 °C (<95 °F) | 7 | | |
| Creatinine, mg/dL (µmol/L) | Highest within 1 hr of ICU admission | <1.2 mg/dL (<106.1 µmol/L) | 0 |
| 1.2-1.9 mg/dL (106.1-176.7 µmol/L) | 2 | | |
| 2-3.4 mg/dL (176.8-309.3 µmol/L) | 7 | | |
| ≥3.5 mg/dL (≥309.4 µmol/L) | 8 | | |
| Heart rate, beats/min | Highest within 1 hr of ICU admission | <120 | 0 |
| 120-159 | 5 | | |
| ≥160 | 7 | | |
| Leukocytes, G/L | Highest within 1 hr of ICU admission | <15 | 0 |
| ≥15 | 2 | | |
| pH | Lowest within 1 hr of ICU admission | >7.25 | 0 |
| ≤7.25 | 3 | | |
| Platelets, G/L | Lowest within 1 hr of ICU admission | ≥100 | 0 |
| 50-99 | 5 | | |
| 20-49 | 8 | | |
| <20 | 13 | | |
| Systolic blood pressure, mm Hg | Lowest within 1 hr of ICU admission | ≥120 | 0 |
| 70-119 | 3 | | |
| 40-69 | 8 | | |
| <40 | 11 | | |
| Oxygenation | | PaO 2 ≥60 and no MV | 0 |
| PaO 2 <60 and no MV | 5 | | |
| PaO 2 /FiO 2 ≥100 and MV | 7 | | |
| PaO 2 /FiO 2 <100 and MV | 11 | | |

In-hospital mortality, % = [e^x^/(1 + e^x^)]*100,

where x = −32.6659 + ln(SAPS 3 score + 20.5958) × 7.3068

how_to_use.why: Les auteurs émettent l’hypothèse que les facteurs liés au patient et les circonstances entourant l’admission en réanimation — **combinés** aux perturbations physiologiques du patient à l’admission en réanimation — donnent une meilleure vision du pronostic d’un patient en réanimation.
how_to_use.when: À l’admission en réanimation pour prédire la mortalité hospitalière.
how_to_use.pearls: Physiologic variables are meant to be assessed within 1 hour of ICU admission.

next_steps.advice:
- Tous les patients bénéficient d'un décalage de 16 points afin d'éviter des scores négatifs.
- À mesure que le score total augmente, la probabilité de mortalité intra-hospitalière augmente également.
- Le SAPS 3 peut être utilisé pour guider les discussions concernant le pronostic et les objectifs de soins des patients admis en unité de soins intensifs.

medium_description: Estimates probabilité de mortalité pour ICU patients sur admission.

instructions: Le score SAPS 3 prédit la mortalité hospitalière à l'admission en réanimation, en se fondant sur les caractéristiques des patients, l'indication d'admission en réanimation et les perturbations physiologiques à l'admission en réanimation.
